name: FNCE 5533
title: Real Estate Capital Markets
description: Structure and operation of the mortgage market. Topics include the identification, measurement and management of risk from the perspective of borrower, lender, and investor. Stresses the integration of the real estate debt markets with the global capital market, and considers the role and impact of mortgage-backed securities for residential and commercial real estate lending.
requirement_description: FNCE 5101 or FNCE 5182; open to MBA students, others with consent.
